description: What the saving host knew about one third-party effect plug-in the document uses. The plug-in's code is not in the package. EffectCraft effect plug-ins have no private state beyond their declared parameters, which are ordinary properties of the effect instance; this record is therefore the plug-in's own manifest, kept so a reader can tell which plug-in, in which version, an effect id stood for.

api.description: The plug-in interface version the host loaded it with.

manifest.description: The plug-in's manifest as the host read it, verbatim (opaque to this profile); null when the host did not have it.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile motion-comp/1; a reader refuses the node (node scope) when it is anything else.

version.description: The plug-in's version as its manifest states it; empty when unknown.

title: x.effectcraft.plugin-state
